write_file.description: Creates or replaces a whole file under .sdd/ (C002-REQ-403). Missing parent folders inside .sdd/ are created.

inputSchema.title: write_file input
inputSchema.description: Creates or replaces a whole file under .sdd/ (C002-REQ-403). Missing parent folders inside .sdd/ are created.

path.description: Target file: absolute, or relative to the server's repository root (sdd-mcp-server.md §3). The path guard core decides it (C002-REQ-401).

content.description: Complete new file content, written as UTF-8 without BOM, line endings unchanged.

findings.description: Quick-lint findings of the written file in the post-write feedback format of C001-IF-07 §4 (C002-REQ-408).

lines.description: At most 15 findings, errors before warnings before info, each in the CLI human format of C001-IF-01; when total > 15 a last line '… <n> more: run sdd lint --quick --file <path>'.

findings_unavailable.description: Present instead of findings when the quick-lint check could not run (C002-REQ-409).

replace_text.description: Replaces one exact text span in an existing file under .sdd/ (C002-REQ-403); the span must occur exactly once (C002-REQ-404).

inputSchema.title: replace_text input
inputSchema.description: Replaces one exact text span in an existing file under .sdd/ (C002-REQ-403); the span must occur exactly once (C002-REQ-404).

path.description: Target file: absolute, or relative to the server's repository root (sdd-mcp-server.md §3). The path guard core decides it (C002-REQ-401).

findings.description: Quick-lint findings of the written file in the post-write feedback format of C001-IF-07 §4 (C002-REQ-408).

lines.description: At most 15 findings, errors before warnings before info, each in the CLI human format of C001-IF-01; when total > 15 a last line '… <n> more: run sdd lint --quick --file <path>'.

findings_unavailable.description: Present instead of findings when the quick-lint check could not run (C002-REQ-409).

run_command.description: Runs one command allowed by the bash guard core (C002-REQ-405), without a shell (C002-CON-07).

inputSchema.title: run_command input
inputSchema.description: Runs one command allowed by the bash guard core (C002-REQ-405), without a shell (C002-CON-07).

dialect.description: Shell syntax the bash guard core applies to the command (sdd-mcp-server.md §5.2); the command runs without a shell in either case.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock limit; the process is killed when it is reached.

outputSchema.title: run_command output
outputSchema.description: Result of an allowed command (C002-REQ-406). A non-zero exit code is a normal result, not an error result (C002-TS-408).

exit_code.description: Exit code of the command's first segment; pipe-only filters never fail. null when the process was killed at the timeout.

stdout.description: Standard output after the pipe-only filters, UTF-8, at most 1,048,576 characters.

stderr.description: Standard error of the first segment, UTF-8, at most 1,048,576 characters.
